# P2K Pole/Zero Atlas — the real format (4 stored corners, 6 flat sections)

Each section is one biquad = a complex pole pair + a complex zero pair. `pole Hz/r` = resonance frequency & radius (r→1 = sharp/screaming, r→0 = gone). Hz=0 marks a real (non-resonant) root.
